289 likes, 92 comments - anahitadhondy on October 5, 2026: "I’ve been testing Ember’s MarvelOven for months before launch, and somewhere along the way, my big oven just stopped getting used.

It’s small, yet it really does it all. Late-night cravings, quick lunches, the things I’d usually talk myself out of making because it felt like too much effort. Now I just make them. It’s changed how often I actually cook for myself, not just for work.

Safe to say, this one’s earned its spot in my kitchen.
Comment ‘MARVEL’ for the link. 🤍".
